# What this notebook does

Kate, 2026-10-20: a model-free alternative to the SHAP clustering in `26b_target_subtypes_features.Rmd`.

1. **Background = every gene with a TE LFC** in the DESeq2 table that also has a row in the
   feature matrix (genes without features cannot be scored).
2. **Each feature is z-scored against that background**: z = (gene value - background mean) /
   background sd. A target's z-score therefore says how unusual it is *compared with a typical
   measured mRNA*, in sd units, so features on different scales become comparable.
3. **Only the `r params$set_word` are clustered** (k-means on their z-score profiles). Nothing
   from the forest is used: no SHAP, no predictions. The forest's run is read only for its list
   of 57 intrinsic features, so the rows match the SHAP heatmaps and the two can be compared.

How this differs from SHAP clustering: SHAP groups genes by *why the model scores them*, so
features the model ignores carry no weight. Here every feature carries weight in proportion to
how unusual the gene is on it, whether or not it relates to TE. Two consequences:

- **Correlated features count several times.** The GC family has many near-duplicate columns,
  so GC differences pull harder on the clustering than one feature would.
- **Outliers must be tamed.** Some features are extremely skewed (max |z| near 100), and k-means
  would give a single extreme gene its own cluster. z is capped at +/-`r params$z_cap` before
  clustering, and missing values are set to 0 (= the transcriptome mean). Section 7 checks that
  the clusters do not depend on either choice.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse); library(here); library(cluster); library(pheatmap); library(grid)
})
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
ks <- as.integer(strsplit(params$ks, ",")[[1]])
K <- as.integer(params$k_report)
ZC <- params$z_cap
SAVE <- isTRUE(params$save_plots)
lab_set <- paste(params$label, params$set_word)
pf <- function(x) here("plots", paste0("26c_target_zclust_", params$tag, "_", x))
cl_cols <- c("#0072B2", "#CC79A7", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#D55E00", "#56B4E9", "grey40", "#882255")
stopifnot("k_report must be one of ks" = K %in% ks, "z_cap must be positive" = ZC > 0)
```

# 1. Background, features and targets

```{r load}
de <- read_csv(here("output", params$de_file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("[.].*", "", gene_id))
stopifnot("DE table has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(de$gene_id_clean),
          "DE table lacks te_lfc / te_padj" = all(c("te_lfc", "te_padj") %in% names(de)))
# Direction check: the siRNA depletes its own target, so EIF3D must be strongly positive in log2(sictrl / si3d)
eif3d <- de$rna_lfc[de$symbol %in% "EIF3D"]
stopifnot("EIF3D not found once in the DE table" = length(eif3d) == 1,
          "EIF3D rna_lfc not > 1 - wrong file or flipped direction" = eif3d > 1)
cat(sprintf("%s: EIF3D rna_lfc = %.2f (knockdown confirmed, positive = eIF3d promotes)\n", params$de_file, eif3d))

fm <- readRDS(file.path(O, params$matrix_rds))
stopifnot("feature matrix has duplicate genes" = !anyDuplicated(fm$gene_id_clean))
fc <- readRDS(file.path(O, paste0("rfreg_model_data_", params$features_from, ".rds")))$feature_cols
stopifnot("features missing from the matrix" = all(fc %in% names(fm)))
ann <- read_csv(file.path(O, "feature_annotation.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
fam <- setNames(ann$family[match(fc, ann$feature)], fc)
stopifnot("a feature has no family" = !anyNA(fam))
rows <- fc[order(fam, fc)]          # same row order as the 26b SHAP heatmaps

bg <- de %>% filter(!is.na(te_lfc), gene_id_clean %in% fm$gene_id_clean) %>% arrange(gene_id_clean)
X <- fm[match(bg$gene_id_clean, fm$gene_id_clean), rows] %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(unlist(.x)))) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(X) <- bg$gene_id_clean
stopifnot("ACTB CDS GC outside 50-70%" = between(X[bg$symbol %in% "ACTB", "cds_gc"], 50, 70),
          "background unexpectedly small" = nrow(bg) > 9000)

tg <- bg$te_lfc > 0.5 & !is.na(bg$te_padj) & bg$te_padj < 0.05
gs <- sub("[.].*", "", read_csv(here("output", "genesets", params$geneset_csv), show_col_types = FALSE)$ensembl_gene)
stopifnot("targets differ from the saved gene-set CSV" = setequal(bg$gene_id_clean[tg], intersect(gs, bg$gene_id_clean)))
genes <- bg[tg, ]
cat(sprintf("background: %s genes with a TE LFC and features (of %s in the DE table, %s in the matrix)\n",
            format(nrow(bg), big.mark = ","), format(sum(!is.na(de$te_lfc)), big.mark = ","), format(nrow(fm), big.mark = ",")))
cat(sprintf("targets: %d (TE LFC > 0.5, padj < 0.05; = %s within the background, %d of %d CSV genes have features)\n",
            nrow(genes), params$geneset_csv, nrow(genes), length(gs)))
cat(sprintf("features: %d in %d families\n", length(rows), n_distinct(fam)))
```

# 2. Z-scores against the transcriptome

```{r zscores}
mu <- colMeans(X, na.rm = TRUE); sdv <- apply(X, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
stopifnot("a feature is constant across the background" = all(sdv > 0))
Z_full <- sweep(sweep(X, 2, mu), 2, sdv, "/")                  # uncapped, NA kept
stopifnot("background z not mean 0" = max(abs(colMeans(Z_full, na.rm = TRUE))) < 1e-9,
          "background z not sd 1" = max(abs(apply(Z_full, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE) - 1)) < 1e-9)
prep <- function(Z, cap = ZC) { Z[is.na(Z)] <- 0; pmin(pmax(Z, -cap), cap) }
Zt_full <- Z_full[genes$gene_id_clean, , drop = FALSE]
Zt <- prep(Zt_full)                                           # what k-means sees
stopifnot("target rows out of step" = identical(rownames(Zt), genes$gene_id_clean))

tibble(feature = rows, family = fam[rows],
       targets_missing = colSums(is.na(Zt_full)),
       targets_capped = colSums(abs(Zt_full) > ZC, na.rm = TRUE),
       target_mean_z = colMeans(Zt_full, na.rm = TRUE),
       max_abs_z_background = apply(abs(Z_full), 2, max, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(target_mean_z))) %>% knitr::kable(digits = 2)
cat(sprintf("target cells: %d missing set to 0, %d capped at +/-%g (of %s)\n",
            sum(is.na(Zt_full)), sum(abs(Zt_full) > ZC, na.rm = TRUE), ZC, format(length(Zt_full), big.mark = ",")))
```

# 3. How many clusters

Three views. They should agree before a k is trusted.

- **Elbow, % explained:** 1 - WSS(k) / WSS(1), where WSS is the total squared distance from each
  gene to its cluster centre. The grey curve is the same for z-scores shuffled within each
  feature (destroys which features go together, keeps each feature's distribution).
- **Elbow, raw WSS (pheatmap `kmeans_k`, one start):** the lab's teaching-code version.
- **Silhouette vs the shuffled null:** for each gene, (b - a) / max(a, b), a = mean distance to
  its own cluster, b = to the nearest other; mean over genes. Observed is compared within each k
  against `r params$n_perm` shuffles, as in 26b.

```{r elbow, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
wss <- function(M, k) { set.seed(9); kmeans(M, k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 50)$tot.withinss }
obs <- vapply(1:8, function(k) wss(Zt, k), numeric(1))
shuf <- rowMeans(vapply(1:10, function(i) { set.seed(1000 + i); P <- apply(Zt, 2, sample)
  vapply(1:8, function(k) wss(P, k), numeric(1)) }, numeric(8)))
elbow <- tibble(k = 1:8, real = 100 * (1 - obs / obs[1]), shuffled = 100 * (1 - shuf / shuf[1])) %>%
  mutate(gain_real = real - lag(real), gain_shuffled = shuffled - lag(shuffled))
knitr::kable(elbow, digits = 1)
p_elbow <- elbow %>% pivot_longer(c(real, shuffled), names_to = "data") %>%
  ggplot(aes(k, value, colour = data, linetype = data)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = K, colour = "grey80") + geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point() +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(real = "#E69F00", shuffled = "grey50"), name = NULL,
                      labels = c(real = "real z-scores", shuffled = "shuffled z-scores\n(no real groups)")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(real = 1, shuffled = 2), name = NULL,
                        labels = c(real = "real z-scores", shuffled = "shuffled z-scores\n(no real groups)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:8) +
  labs(x = "number of clusters (k)", y = "% of variance explained by clusters",
       title = sprintf("%s:\nk-means elbow plot, feature z-scores", lab_set),
       subtitle = sprintf("z vs %s background genes; shuffled = mean of 10; grey line = k = %d; n = %s targets",
                          format(nrow(bg), big.mark = ","), K, format(nrow(genes), big.mark = ","))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
p_elbow
if (SAVE) ggsave(pf("elbow.pdf"), p_elbow, width = 7, height = 4.5)
```

```{r elbow_pheatmap, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
wss_ph <- function(knum, x) pheatmap::pheatmap(mat = x, kmeans_k = knum, scale = "none", cluster_cols = FALSE,
                                               clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean", clustering_method = "ward.D2",
                                               silent = TRUE)$kmeans$tot.withinss
k2test <- 2:15
set.seed(9)
elbow_ph <- tibble(k = k2test, wss_pheatmap = map_vec(k2test, wss_ph, x = Zt),
                   wss_25_starts = map_vec(k2test, function(k) { set.seed(9); kmeans(Zt, k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)$tot.withinss }))
# Best-of-25 is usually but not necessarily lower: pheatmap's single start is not one of the 25.
cat(sprintf("k where the single start beat best-of-25: %s\n", paste(elbow_ph$k[elbow_ph$wss_pheatmap < elbow_ph$wss_25_starts - 1e-9], collapse = ", ")))
knitr::kable(elbow_ph %>% mutate(single_start_excess_pct = 100 * (wss_pheatmap / wss_25_starts - 1)), digits = 1)
p_elbow_ph <- ggplot(elbow_ph, aes(k, wss_pheatmap)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = K, colour = "grey80") + geom_line(colour = "grey50") + geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k2test) +
  labs(x = "number of clusters K", y = "total within-cluster sum of squares",
       title = sprintf("%s:\nk-means elbow plot (pheatmap kmeans_k), feature z-scores", lab_set),
       subtitle = sprintf("one k-means start per k, set.seed(9); grey line = k = %d; n = %s targets", K, format(nrow(genes), big.mark = ","))) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot(font_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
p_elbow_ph
if (SAVE) ggsave(pf("elbow_wss_pheatmap.pdf"), p_elbow_ph, width = 7, height = 4.5)
```

```{r null, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5}
D <- dist(Zt)
sil_of <- function(M, k, d = dist(M)) {
  set.seed(9); km <- kmeans(M, centers = k, nstart = 10, iter.max = 50)
  mean(silhouette(km$cluster, d)[, 3])
}
null_cache <- file.path(O, "shap_oof_cache", sprintf("nulls_zclust_%s_cap%g_perm%d_k%s.rds",
                                                     params$tag, ZC, params$n_perm, gsub(",", "-", params$ks)))
fp <- c(nrow(Zt), round(sum(abs(Zt)), 6))
cached <- if (file.exists(null_cache)) readRDS(null_cache) else NULL
if (!is.null(cached) && identical(cached$fingerprint, fp)) nl <- cached else {
  nm <- t(vapply(seq_len(params$n_perm), function(i) { set.seed(1000 + i); P <- apply(Zt, 2, sample)
    dP <- dist(P); vapply(ks, function(k) sil_of(P, k, dP), numeric(1)) }, numeric(length(ks))))
  nl <- list(fingerprint = fp, null = nm)
  if (SAVE) saveRDS(nl, null_cache)
}
sil_obs <- vapply(ks, function(k) sil_of(Zt, k, D), numeric(1))
nm <- nl$null
z <- (sil_obs - colMeans(nm)) / apply(nm, 2, sd)
z_null <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(nm)), function(i) { m2 <- nm[-i, , drop = FALSE]
  max((nm[i, ] - colMeans(m2)) / apply(m2, 2, sd)) }, numeric(1))
band <- tibble(k = ks, observed = sil_obs, null_median = apply(nm, 2, median),
               null_min = apply(nm, 2, min), null_max = apply(nm, 2, max), z = z)
knitr::kable(band, digits = 4)
best_k_sil <- ks[which.max(sil_obs)]; best_k_z <- ks[which.max(z)]
cat(sprintf("silhouette peak k = %d | best supported vs null k = %d (z = %.1f) | overall p = %.3f (%d shuffles)\n",
            best_k_sil, best_k_z, max(z), (sum(z_null >= max(z)) + 1) / (nrow(nm) + 1), nrow(nm)))
p_band <- ggplot(band, aes(k)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = null_min, ymax = null_max), fill = "grey85") +
  geom_line(aes(y = null_median), colour = "grey50", linetype = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = observed), colour = "#E69F00", linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(aes(y = observed), colour = "#E69F00") +
  geom_text(aes(y = observed, label = sprintf("z = %.1f", z)), vjust = -1, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = ks) + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  labs(x = "number of clusters (k)", y = "mean silhouette score",
       title = sprintf("%s:\nsilhouette score, real vs shuffled feature z-scores", lab_set),
       subtitle = sprintf("orange = real; grey band = range over %d shuffles (each feature permuted across genes);\ndashed = shuffled median; z = (real - shuffled mean) / shuffled sd; n = %s targets",
                          nrow(nm), format(nrow(genes), big.mark = ","))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12), plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9))
p_band
if (SAVE) ggsave(pf("silhouette_null_band.pdf"), p_band, width = 7, height = 4.5)
```

# 4. Heatmaps of per-gene z-scores

Genes are columns, ordered by cluster and, within a cluster, by TE change; features are rows,
grouped by family as in the SHAP heatmaps. Color = the gene's z-score against all background
genes (orange higher than a typical mRNA, blue lower), capped at +/-`r params$z_cap`, exactly the
values k-means saw. Drawn at k = `r params$k_report` (`k_report`) and at the silhouette peak if different.

```{r heatmaps, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 11, results = "asis"}
fam_cols <- setNames(colorRampPalette(c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2",
                                        "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "grey50"))(n_distinct(fam)), sort(unique(fam)))
sym <- function(x, cap = 1.5) { x <- pmin(pmax(x, -cap), cap); x[c(which.min(x), which.max(x))] <- c(-cap, cap); x }
cluster_k <- function(M, k) {
  set.seed(9); cl <- kmeans(M, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 50)$cluster
  match(cl, as.integer(names(sort(table(cl), decreasing = TRUE))))   # largest = 1
}
assignments <- list()
for (k in unique(c(K, best_k_sil))) {
  cl <- cluster_k(Zt, k)
  assignments[[as.character(k)]] <- tibble(gene_id_clean = genes$gene_id_clean, symbol = genes$symbol, k = k,
                                           cluster = cl, te_lfc = genes$te_lfc)
  ord <- order(cl, -genes$te_lfc)
  H <- t(Zt[ord, rows, drop = FALSE])
  acol <- data.frame(cluster = factor(cl[ord]), lfc = sym(genes$te_lfc[ord]), check.names = FALSE, row.names = colnames(H))
  names(acol)[2] <- params$lfc_label
  acols <- list(cluster = setNames(cl_cols[seq_len(k)], seq_len(k)),
                lfc_tmp = colorRampPalette(c("#0072B2", "white", "#D55E00"))(51), family = fam_cols)
  names(acols)[names(acols) == "lfc_tmp"] <- params$lfc_label
  hm <- pheatmap::pheatmap(H, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, show_colnames = FALSE,
                 color = colorRampPalette(c("#0072B2", "white", "#D55E00"))(101),
                 breaks = seq(-ZC, ZC, length.out = 102), annotation_col = acol,
                 annotation_row = data.frame(family = fam[rows], row.names = rows),
                 annotation_colors = acols, gaps_col = cumsum(table(cl))[-k], fontsize_row = 6,
                 main = sprintf("%s (n = %s genes)\nclustered on feature z-scores | k-means k = %d%s\ncolor = z-score vs all %s genes with a TE LFC (orange higher, blue lower, capped at +/-%g; missing = 0)",
                                lab_set, format(nrow(genes), big.mark = ","), k,
                                if (k == best_k_sil && k != K) " (silhouette peak)" else "",
                                format(nrow(bg), big.mark = ","), ZC),
                 fontsize = 9, silent = TRUE)
  cat("\n\n## k = ", k, "\n\n", sep = ""); grid.newpage(); grid.draw(hm$gtable)
  if (SAVE) {
    png(pf(paste0("heatmap_k", k, ".png")), width = 14, height = 11, units = "in", res = 300); grid.newpage(); grid.draw(hm$gtable); dev.off()
    pdf(pf(paste0("heatmap_k", k, ".pdf")), width = 14, height = 11); grid.newpage(); grid.draw(hm$gtable); dev.off()
  }
}
```

# 5. Mean z-score per cluster

One column per group: all targets, then each k = `r params$k_report` cluster. Each cell is the group's mean
z-score on the **uncapped** values over the genes that have one, so it reads directly as "this
cluster sits X sd above a typical mRNA". The number is printed in each cell.

```{r mean_panel, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 11}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(ComplexHeatmap); library(circlize) })
clK <- assignments[[as.character(K)]]$cluster
grp <- c(list(`all targets` = rep(TRUE, nrow(genes))), setNames(lapply(seq_len(K), function(g) clK == g), paste("cluster", seq_len(K))))
zmean <- sapply(grp, function(w) colMeans(Zt_full[w, rows, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE))
colnames(zmean) <- sprintf("%s\n(n = %s)", names(grp), format(map_int(grp, sum), big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE))
# independent recomputation from the raw values: (cluster mean - background mean) / background sd
chk <- sapply(seq_len(K), function(g) (colMeans(X[genes$gene_id_clean[clK == g], rows, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE) - mu[rows]) / sdv[rows])
stopifnot("cluster mean z does not match the raw-value recomputation" = max(abs(chk - zmean[, -1])) < 1e-9)
zcap <- max(1, quantile(abs(zmean), 0.98, na.rm = TRUE))
ht <- Heatmap(zmean, name = "mean z-score\nvs background",
              left_annotation = rowAnnotation(family = fam[rows], col = list(family = fam_cols), show_annotation_name = FALSE),
              col = colorRamp2(c(-zcap, 0, zcap), c("#0072B2", "white", "#D55E00")),
              cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE, row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6.5),
              column_names_rot = 45, column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
              cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, fill) grid.text(sprintf("%.2f", zmean[i, j]), x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 5.5, col = "grey20")),
              column_title = sprintf("(group mean - mean of %s background genes) / background sd", format(nrow(bg), big.mark = ",")),
              column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9))
draw_mean <- function() draw(ht, merge_legend = TRUE, column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
                             column_title = sprintf("%s\nmean feature z-score per cluster (z-score clusters, k = %d)", lab_set, K))
draw_mean()
if (SAVE) {
  pdf(pf(paste0("cluster_mean_k", K, ".pdf")), width = 7, height = 11); draw_mean(); dev.off()
  png(pf(paste0("cluster_mean_k", K, ".png")), width = 7, height = 11, units = "in", res = 300); draw_mean(); dev.off()
}
```

```{r cluster_summary}
seqv <- tibble(gene_id_clean = rownames(X), cds_gc = X[, "cds_gc"], gc3 = X[, "gc3_internal"],
               cds_nt = 2^X[, "log2_cds_length"] - 1, utr5_nt = 2^X[, "log2_utr5_length"] - 1,
               utr3_nt = 2^X[, "log2_utr3_length"] - 1)
top <- map_dfr(seq_len(K), function(g) { m <- zmean[, g + 1]; o <- order(-abs(m))[1:5]
  tibble(cluster = g, top_features = paste0(rows[o], sprintf(" (%+.1f)", m[o]), collapse = ", ")) })
summ <- assignments[[as.character(K)]] %>% left_join(seqv, by = "gene_id_clean") %>% group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), median_te_lfc = median(te_lfc), cds_gc = median(cds_gc, na.rm = TRUE), gc3 = median(gc3, na.rm = TRUE),
            cds_nt = median(cds_nt, na.rm = TRUE), utr5_nt = median(utr5_nt, na.rm = TRUE),
            utr3_nt = median(utr3_nt, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(top, by = "cluster")
bg_row <- seqv %>% summarise(cds_gc = median(cds_gc, na.rm = TRUE), gc3 = median(gc3, na.rm = TRUE), cds_nt = median(cds_nt, na.rm = TRUE),
                             utr5_nt = median(utr5_nt, na.rm = TRUE), utr3_nt = median(utr3_nt, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(cluster = NA, n = nrow(bg), median_te_lfc = median(bg$te_lfc), top_features = "background (all genes with a TE LFC)")
knitr::kable(bind_rows(summ, bg_row), digits = 1)
kw <- kruskal.test(te_lfc ~ factor(cluster), data = assignments[[as.character(K)]])
cat(sprintf("TE LFC differs between clusters? Kruskal-Wallis p = %.3g\n", kw$p.value))
if (SAVE) {
  write_csv(bind_rows(assignments), file.path(O, paste0("target_zscore_clusters_", params$tag, ".csv")))
  write_csv(bind_rows(summ, bg_row), file.path(O, paste0("target_zscore_cluster_summary_", params$tag, ".csv")))
  write_csv(as_tibble(zmean, rownames = "feature") %>% mutate(family = fam[feature], .after = feature),
            file.path(O, paste0("target_zscore_cluster_means_", params$tag, ".csv")))
}
```

# 6. Same genes, same groups as the SHAP clustering?

Cross-tabulation against the k = `r params$k_report` SHAP clusters from 26b (both profiles) and the adjusted Rand
index (ARI: 1 = identical partitions, 0 = no more agreement than chance).

```{r vs_shap}
f_shap <- file.path(O, paste0("target_shap_feature_clusters_", params$features_from, ".csv"))
if (file.exists(f_shap)) {
  shap_cl <- read_csv(f_shap, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% filter(k == K)
  for (p in unique(shap_cl$profile)) {
    s <- shap_cl %>% filter(profile == p)
    stopifnot("SHAP clustering covers different genes" = setequal(s$gene_id_clean, genes$gene_id_clean))
    zc <- clK[match(s$gene_id_clean, genes$gene_id_clean)]
    cat(sprintf("\nSHAP %s k = %d vs z-score k = %d: ARI = %.2f\n", p, K, K, mclust::adjustedRandIndex(s$cluster, zc)))
    print(table(`SHAP cluster` = s$cluster, `z-score cluster` = zc))
  }
} else cat("no SHAP clustering CSV for", params$features_from, "- knit 26b first to compare\n")
```

# 7. Do the clusters depend on the cap or the missing-value fill?

The k = `r params$k_report` clustering redone three ways and compared by ARI with the one shown above:
a looser cap (+/-5), no cap at all, and rank-based z-scores (each feature converted to normal
scores over the background, which removes skew without a cap). High ARI = the choice did not
matter.

```{r robustness}
rank_z <- apply(X, 2, function(x) qnorm((rank(x, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(x))))
rownames(rank_z) <- rownames(X)
alt <- list(`cap +/-5` = prep(Zt_full, 5), `no cap` = prep(Zt_full, Inf),
            `rank-based z` = prep(rank_z[genes$gene_id_clean, rows], Inf))
tibble(variant = names(alt), ARI_vs_shown = map_dbl(alt, ~ mclust::adjustedRandIndex(cluster_k(.x, K), clK)),
       cluster_sizes = map_chr(alt, ~ paste(tabulate(cluster_k(.x, K)), collapse = "/"))) %>%
  bind_rows(tibble(variant = sprintf("shown (cap +/-%g)", ZC), ARI_vs_shown = 1, cluster_sizes = paste(tabulate(clK), collapse = "/")), .) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
